## Change

Describe the species or indicator added and its ecological evidence.

## Evidence and uncertainty

Link sources. Separate supported habitat relationships from provisional numerical settings; explain data gaps and regional limits.

## Checks

- [ ] Read CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test` pass (or explain what you could not run).
- [ ] Names, notes and new visible indicator labels have all five translations.
- [ ] Verified species switching, model details and missing inputs in the browser.
- [ ] No private collecting locations or claims of calibrated encounter probabilities.
